主要内容: On August 5, 2014, Asta Funding, Inc. filed a lawsuit against Unifund CCR Partners, a debt buyer based in Cincinnati, Ohio. The lawsuit alleges that Unifund has failed to pay Asta Funding certain amounts due under a servicing agreement. According to the agreement, if Asta Funding does not recover a specified amount within a specified time period, it is entitled to 50% of the fee premium distributed to Unifund. The lawsuit claims that Unifund retained the entire fee premium instead of paying Asta Funding 50%, and the company is seeking at least $19 million in damages.
